next.reason: 1989: argument-2 'must be a nonnumeric literal or alphanumeric data item', no content rule. §2023:15.68.3 AR2: 'shall be of the same class as argument-1' (alphanumeric or national per §2023:15.68.3 AR1), shall contain a non-space character and shall not contain digits, '*', '+', '-', ',', '.', 'CR' or 'DB'. National is added and those currency strings, valid in 1989, are now refused. Differs both ways.
